records.title: ViCuR: Visual Cues as Recoverable Privilege for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: ViCuR adds a sink-token cue-recovery module during prefill and improves multimodal reasoning on seven benchmarks while preserving the inference interface; it is a distillation/training method, not a measured latency or memory optimization. Cue quality is a stated limitation.

records.title: Your Teacher Can't Help You Here: Combating Supervision Fidelity Decay in On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: Lookahead Group Reward uses entropy-triggered tree attention during on-policy distillation and improves long-generation math/code scores (including +4.92 on AIME-26 at 39k tokens). It is training-side efficiency and accuracy, not demonstrated inference acceleration.
